source.extraction: First HTML pre block; remove HTML tags, HTML-unescape once, UTF-8 encode; preserve leading and trailing whitespace.

patches.reason: Use an unsigned byte accumulator so the eight-bit left shifts and N=9 zero-padding behavior are defined; preserve the scalar pixel and row-packing algorithm.

differences: Both preserve the scalar 50-iteration escape test, f64 coordinate formulas, row-major order and complete P4 output. C uses double loop counters and an unsigned char accumulator; YIAN converts bounded i32 coordinates to f64 and uses a u64 accumulator before storing each byte in a row Vec.

C parses side length from argv and prints bytes with putc; YIAN receives the selected side through the bench-scale marker and writes a buffered row slice. Both pack MSB-first and zero the low unused bits at each row end.
